This file contains covariates and ancestry assignments used in the Pan-UK Biobank Project. The covariates used in all SAIGE regression models for GWAS were:
Principal components (PCs) 1-10
age
sex
age * sex
age2
age2 * sex

This file includes additional PCs, population labels, and relatedness information, as determined by PC-Relate. More detailed information about the iterative ancestry assignment process can be found here: https://pan.ukbb.broadinstitute.org/docs/qc#sample-qc.
